summary: xAI launched a built-in plugin marketplace for Grok Build that lets developers browse, install and update partner-built plugins bundling skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers and LSPs from the CLI.

practices.reason: Adds an optional plugin ecosystem and CLI commands to Grok Build that a team could adopt if using partner integrations like MongoDB or Sentry, but nothing forces migration.
practices.quote: Inside Grok Build, type /marketplace to browse the catalog and press i to install a plugin. Or use the CLI directly: Copy grok plugin marketplace list grok plugin install < nam e > --trust bash
